trust_decision.summary: Whether an internal-auth bootstrap admin is given a password the operator chose or a known shipped default (cleartext 'sipcapture'); decided by config default injection (decodeCoordinatorAuthHook / normalizeCoordinatorAuth) and materialised into the users.password_hash row at coordinator startup and by the CLI recovery/wizard paths.

landing_point.why: The advisory names a hardcoded default admin password; grepping for 'sipcapture' lands on the exported constant whose comment says 'cleartext: sipcapture', and the default it feeds is injected in the same file.

fix_sites.entry_point: homer --config-path with coordinator.auth object {"type":"internal"} and no hash
config.SaveExample (writes an example config whose empty hash reloads as the default)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The wizard is a separate TUI config generator in another package that writes an explicit hash the operator typed; the advisory is about the server's built-in first-login default, so the wizard can be argued out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An explicit admin_password_hash (including the sipcapture SHA-256 shipped for Docker) and an existing users row must keep authenticating, and legacy SHA-256 hashes must stay verifiable; a fix that rejects SHA-256 at login or rewrites existing rows breaks documented upgrade behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: coordinator.auth as the JSON string "internal" (decode hook path, sets the hash directly)
coordinator.auth as {"type":"internal"} with no admin_password_hash (normalizer path)
coordinator.auth omitted entirely (empty type normalizes to internal)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: homer --reset-admin-password with auth string "internal" (or object without admin_password_hash) silently writes the sipcapture hash into the admin users row: its empty-hash guard is defeated because config.Load already filled the default.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: reset_admin.go already refuses an empty admin_password_hash, so a solver reads that guard as the protection and treats a separate recovery CLI as out of scope for a first-login bootstrap bug.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package src/cli, 2 packages from the src/config landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: homer wizard --profile coordinator|node|all-in-one writes baseConfig whose Auth.AdminPasswordHash is the sipcapture constant (silently dropped again by AuthConfig.MarshalJSON), so the generated config reloads into the known default.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: presets are template generators the operator is expected to edit; the advisory names the first-login bootstrap, not generated config files.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package/file as the TUI save path, ~400 lines away

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a post-Load fallback that defaults AdminPasswordHash the way AdminUser is defaulted here
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this pass already fills every other zero-valued coordinator field, so a maintainer adding a 'safe default' password hash would naturally land here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a serializer that omits the hash it was given when it equals the default, so save/reload re-applies the default
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the code already special-cases exactly this constant in MarshalJSON, and saveConfig round-trips configs through it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a repair branch that refills an existing admin row's empty password_hash from the configured/default hash
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: legacy rows are already repaired from config here, so a default can re-enter through a reload/repair path.
shows the repo's established random-initial-password pattern, so a sibling that forgets it is plausible.
